title: Naomi Wants To Face Lana On MTV's Safe Word & Would Like To Appear On Dancing With The Stars
htmlContent: We are three days away from the first ever WWE  All-Women Pay Per View "Evolution," and I recently had the opportunity to speak with former Two-Time Smackdown Women's Champion  Trinity "Naomi" Fatu about the upcoming event. Also, I asked her which WWE Women’s division Superstar would like to face on MTV's Safe Word. "My good friend Lana. We’re always competing with each other about everything.  She is very competitive and does not back down. I love her!" Naomi told me. Naomi added that she is interested in make an appearance on Dancing With The Stars: "I’m always down for a good dance segment on the show it’s always fun and entertaining.  Being on Dancing with the Stars is a dream of mine. I think it would be a good challenge because although I have a dance background, I have no experience in ballroom dancing.  I would also like to see if I could do as good if not better than my girl Nikki Bella." WWE Evolution is this Sunday and it can be seen on the WWE Network.
